_comment: Single source of truth for MediaStack setup-wizard prompt regexes (Python 're' flavor, as consumed by tests/lib/wizard_pty.py). Both wizard-driven test surfaces build their PTY steps from these definitions: the DinD wizard-ui-stage3-* scenarios (via tests/lib/wizard_steps_build.py) and the maintainer-private bare-metal harness. Change a prompt HERE and both surfaces track it automatically — no silent drift (the F-001 failure class). Values are JSON-escaped regexes: a literal '?' is matched with '\?'.

prompts.stage1_storage_location: Where should MediaStack store media and downloads\?
prompts.stage1_bazarr: Enable automatic subtitle downloads with Bazarr\?
prompts.stage1_smb: Enable SMB file share for LAN file access\?
prompts.stage1_quality_size: Choose how much storage to spend per movie/show:
prompts.stage1_indexers: Enable the example public-tracker indexer preset\?
prompts.stage1_image_channel: Choose how MediaStack should update container images:
prompts.driver_mode: How should MediaStack set up the NVIDIA driver\?
prompts.unlock_patch_offer: Install the patch-managed driver and apply nvidia-patch\?
prompts.stage1_nas_share_empty: NAS share is empty and ready for MediaStack\.
prompts.stage1_nas_storage_check_failed: NAS storage check failed\. What should setup do\?
prompts.stage1_nas_mount_failed: NAS mount failed\. What should setup do\?
prompts.stage1_nas_manual_guard: Still enable NAS mount guard/watchdog for this manual storage\?
prompts.stage1_smb_port_conflict: SMB needs TCP port 445\. What should setup do\?
prompts.stage2_have_domain: Do you already have a domain name
prompts.stage2_static_ip: Does your home internet have a static.*public IP\?
prompts.stage2_dynu_recommended: Dynu is recommended because the free tier supports wildcard records
prompts.stage2_vpn_level: VPN access level for your admin device
prompts.stage2_https_not_ready: HTTPS is not ready. Choose how to continue:
prompts.stage2_router_forwarding: Fix the router forwarding, then choose:
